items.title: `K_FIRAS = S_IC^cap` coincidence at 3.5% — test for hidden 1-parameter closed form
items.what: parameterize the 3.50% residual as a function of one framework constant (e.g., `tau_fold`, `c_Gold`, `v_F`) and fit. Determine whether the residual is algebraic (closed-form = 0 under exact framework constants) or numerical (residual survives at machine precision under exact constants).
items.inputs: W5-57 `μ(K=2.035) = 4.9759×10⁻¹⁰`, W5-65 `K_FIRAS = 3.6808×10⁵`, `S_IC^cap = 3.5563×10⁵`, canonical_constants with full provenance; L_max = {5, 7, 9} for drift control.
